purpose: Discovery registry for replaceable typed decision models. Presence is not promotion evidence.

integration_policy.system_one_wire_compatible: Use SystemOneDecisionBackend and generic System One benchmark CLI. No model-specific core class.
integration_policy.non_wire_typed_decision: Use CallableDecisionBackend / --decision-callable first. Permanent integration only after API stability and benchmark evidence.
integration_policy.authority: All providers are bounded by locally registered finite IDs. Compatibility never creates execution authority.

candidates.integration_path: LayaDecisionBackend for product; callable/research harness for native noul variants
candidates.notes: Current pinned English/multilingual checkpoints are rejected for SchemaRouter v4 direct choice and winner-only noul. typed-decisions is a separate fine-tuned checkpoint and requires an independent pinned experiment before any claim.
Larger sizes require separate preregistered runs; do not extrapolate from 0.8B.
Serving/runtime layer with interchangeable engines including Laya and Kev; benchmark the underlying engine and runtime identity separately.

candidates.license: MIT for runtime source; upstream model/runtime assets retain upstream licenses
candidates.notes: Local-first Rust runtime; current first backend is Laya Multilingual. Treat runtime and model evidence separately.

candidates.protocol: typed choice/yes-no/score over arbitrary open LLMs; runtime-specific API
candidates.notes: Levels L0/L1/L2 have different label/calibration requirements. Any level using SchemaRouter labels would be a distinct supervised experiment.

candidates.protocol: typed enum/boolean scoring; no assumed TypeSafe wire compatibility
candidates.notes: Bespoke-Nimble-9B is Qwen3.5-9B-based. Pin model revision and probability temperature semantics before any threshold experiment.

candidates.license: MIT for repository code; verify base-model weight terms for selected checkpoint
candidates.protocol: Jev-style choice/score/noul through project-specific decide API
candidates.integration_path: CallableDecisionBackend / --decision-callable unless exact System One wire compatibility is independently verified
candidates.notes: Gemma-family replica; use external claims only for discovery, never SchemaRouter promotion.

intake_checklist: verify code and weight licenses separately
identify wire-compatible vs callable integration path
freeze any passing semantics before a new zero-overlap confirmation
never use failed fresh confirmation rows for tuning
